title: Tokyo Anime Expo 2026
description: The largest anime convention in Asia returns with studio booths, exclusive merchandise, cosplay contests, and premiere screenings of upcoming seasonal titles.

title: Akihabara Culture Festival
description: A neighborhood-wide celebration of anime, manga, and gaming culture with street performances, pop-up cafes, and live drawing sessions by guest artists.

title: Anime Boston Fall Showcase
description: A fan-run convention featuring industry guests, panels on animation production, a massive artists' alley, and screenings of fan-submitted AMVs.

title: Global Esports Championship Finals
description: The world's top teams compete across three game titles for a combined prize pool of $5 million. Live broadcast expected to reach 40 million concurrent viewers.

title: Indie Games Showcase 2026
description: Over 200 independent game studios exhibit playable demos, with awards for innovation, art direction, and narrative. Open to the public for the first time this year.

title: Retro Gaming Festival
description: A celebration of gaming history with playable vintage hardware, speedrunning tournaments, and panels featuring legendary game designers from the 80s and 90s.

title: Venice International Film Festival 2026
location: Palazzo del Cinema, Venice Lido, Italy
description: The world's oldest film festival celebrates master directors and premieres, featuring an exclusive Denis Villeneuve and Christopher Nolan 70mm retrospective showcase.

title: San Diego Comic-Con: Hall H Movie Showcase
location: San Diego Convention Center, California, USA
description: Marvel Studios and DC Studios take over Hall H with exclusive cast appearances, sneak-peek footage for Spider-Man: Brand New Day, and The Batman Part II reveals.

title: IMAX 70mm Global Film Retrospective
location: BFI IMAX London & Lincoln Square NYC
description: Special one-week-only 15-perf 70mm screenings of Dune: Part Two, Oppenheimer, and Interstellar on the world's largest screens with cinematographer Q&As.

title: Television Critics Panel Week
location: The Beverly Hilton, Los Angeles, USA
description: Network and streaming platforms present their upcoming slates to critics, with cast panels, exclusive sneak peeks, and industry networking events.

title: Series Mania Festival
description: Europe's premier television festival, screening new series from around the world with premieres, creator Q&As, and a competition for best international drama.

title: Streaming Culture Conference
description: A conference exploring how streaming has reshaped television, with talks on viewing habits, algorithm curation, and the future of episodic storytelling.

title: K-Pop World Festival
location: Gocheok Sky Dome, Seoul, South Korea
description: The annual celebration of K-pop's global reach, featuring performances from top groups, fan team competitions, and a showcase of international cover dance teams.

title: Eclipse World Tour — Seoul
location: Jamsil Olympic Stadium, Seoul, South Korea
description: Eclipse performs their first stadium show in their hometown, closing the Asian leg of their world tour with a specially extended setlist and guest appearances.

title: K-Pop Con Fan Convention
description: A fan convention with merch booths, photo opportunities, dance workshops, and panels with industry professionals discussing the future of K-pop.

title: Comic Convention NYC
description: One of the largest comic conventions in North America, with publisher booths, artist alley, cosplay contests, and panels featuring top creators from Marvel, DC, and indie publishers.

title: Indie Comics Fest
description: A festival dedicated to independent and self-published comics, with exhibitor tables, live drawing sessions, and a printing workshop for aspiring creators.

title: Comic Art Workshop Weekend
location: The Drawing Center, New York, USA
description: A hands-on weekend workshop led by professional comic artists, covering penciling, inking, coloring, and lettering for creators at all skill levels.

title: Japan Manga Fair
description: A massive industry event where publishers announce new series, creators sign autographs, and fans get first looks at upcoming manga titles and anime adaptations.

title: Manga Translation Symposium
location: International House of Japan, Tokyo, Japan
description: A gathering of manga translators and editors discussing the art and challenges of bringing Japanese manga to global audiences across different languages.

title: Genghki Manga Artist Tribute
description: A retrospective exhibition honoring legendary manga artists, with original artwork on display, guided tours, and talks about the history of the medium.
